I want to build a mobile and web application called “My Pets Diary”, based on the following journal structure.

The purpose of the app is to help pet owners record, track, and manage their pets’ information, health, growth, and memories.

Core Features & Navigation

Home Dashboard: Quick overview of all pets, reminders, and upcoming events.

Pet Profiles: Each pet has its own profile page with tabs for:

Identity: Name, nickname, species, breed, color, unique features, date of birth, adoption date, breeder, adoption fee, notes.

Short Biography: Origin, background, character, personality, favorite food, favorite toy, likes, dislikes, bond with owner & other pets, signature moments.

Health Control: Vaccination schedule, routine medicine, medical history (vaccination, deworming, sterilization).

Growth & Development: Interactive weight & height tracking chart (per year, per month).

Daily Routine: Feeding schedule (time, type of food, portion size), activity log (walks, playtime, favorite toys), grooming routine.

Special Moments: Ability to upload notes, photos, and videos of memorable moments.

Memorial Page: For pets that have passed away (date, place, cause, burial, farewell notes, last photo).

Diary & General Album: Calendar-style diary to record memos, daily notes, and upload photos.

Important Contacts: Veterinarian, emergency clinic, groomer, pet sitter.

Budget & Expenses:

Monthly budget planner (planned vs actual, notes).

Expense tracker (date, item/service, category, amount, notes).

Medical expenses (treatment, vet/clinic, cost, notes).

Savings goals (goal, target amount, progress, deadline).

To-do List & Wishlist: Tasks with priority/star, checklist items with estimated costs.

Photo Gallery: Upload and view favorite photos for each pet.

Functional Requirements

Users can add multiple pets and switch between profiles easily.

All forms should be editable and savable in local storage or cloud database.

Ability to export selected sections or the full journal to PDF.

Reminder notifications for vaccination, medicine, grooming, or scheduled activities.

Clean UI with pastel tones and simple icons. Tabs or bottom navigation bar for easy access.

Data Model

Pets: {id, name, species, breed, color, birth_date, adoption_date, adoption_fee, breeder, notes}

HealthRecords: {pet_id, vaccination, medicine, deworming, sterilization, medical_history}

GrowthRecords: {pet_id, date, weight, height}

Routine: {pet_id, feeding_schedule, activity_log, grooming}

Diary: {date, memo, photos, videos}

Expenses: {pet_id, category, planned, actual, notes}

Contacts: {type, name, phone, address}

Memorial: {pet_id, date, cause, notes, last_photo}
